name: changelink
description: Gerrit change 페이지에서 Jira 이슈를 조회하고 갱신하는 Chrome 확장

scripts.zip: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');const v=require('./manifest.json').version;const out='changelink-v'+v+'.zip';execSync('zip -r '+out+' manifest.json icons message_types.js content_script.js service_worker.js popup.html popup.js options.html options.js');console.log('Created: '+out);"
